subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool half has shipped?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-reproducible, but the open candidate branches are stale or risky enough that automation should not choose the permanent route/session contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Replace With Focused Route Fix
options.body: Land a new or heavily revised fix that persists or reconstructs non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and includes cron/heartbeat live proof.

options.title: Adopt An Existing Candidate
options.body: Repair and rebase #52236 or #77442 only after addressing stale-thread, wrong-entry, and heartbeat-routing risks.

options.title: Close Remaining Scope
options.body: Close #45082 and the linked candidate PRs if maintainers decide cron/heartbeat thread inheritance is not part of the supported Mattermost contract.

recommendation.title: Replace With Focused Route Fix
recommendation.body: Land a new or heavily revised fix that persists or reconstructs non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and includes cron/heartbeat live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available owner signal for the post-#93424 maintainer choice because that merged fix covered only the message-tool half while this issue still tracks the remaining route/session behavior.
